$comment: Default configuration shipped with the application.
Publisher metadata is filled in for this project. UpdateCheckUrl is deliberately still a
placeholder: it stays unset until there is a published release, which is what keeps the
Check for updates button disabled rather than pointing it at an empty releases page.
Nothing tenant-specific belongs in this file: tenant and client IDs are captured through
the setup wizard and stored in the per-user application data directory instead.
To override locally, create appsettings.Local.json in the application data directory
(shown on the Settings page), or set environment variables.
Publisher-owned multitenant public client used ONLY by automatic tenant setup.
Empty on purpose. This repository ships no client ID: a private identifier committed to
source control is a supply-chain problem. Automatic setup reports itself unavailable
until this is set, and the existing-registration path works regardless.
